purpose: Define the only allowed path for promoting a signal from separate Earth and Space lanes into a shared cross-domain residual.

representation_contract.earth_invariant: event/report rate or source-bounded event feature after reporting-opportunity and policy normalization
representation_contract.space_invariant: transient morphology/timing rate after observation-opportunity, detector and artifact normalization
representation_contract.shared_candidate_invariant: prospectively frozen spatial/temporal feature that can be independently measured in both domains
representation_contract.forbidden_shortcut: A shared keyword, date coincidence, narrative resemblance or post-hoc bin choice cannot define the shared invariant.

verdict_ladder.EARTH_ONLY: Terrestrial/reporting/security residual only; no astronomical corroboration.
verdict_ladder.SPACE_ONLY: Astronomical/detector residual only; no terrestrial corroboration.
verdict_ladder.BOTH_BUT_NONALIGNING: Independent residuals exist but do not share the frozen feature.
verdict_ladder.SHARED_RESIDUAL: At least two independent domains survive their own nulls and share the prospectively frozen feature.
verdict_ladder.BLOCKED: One or both domains lack a valid denominator, detector contract or source binding.

candidate_families: human-made activity correlated with both domains
mechanism_discrimination_if_shared_resid.rule: Unknown physical mechanism is reached only after the ordinary common-cause families have been given tests with power to say no.

canonical_seal: LET EARTH AND SPACE DISAGREE FREELY. AGREEMENT COUNTS ONLY AFTER EACH SIDE HAS SURVIVED ITS OWN FALSIFIERS.
